c2_bad.why: A fixed 16:9 media poster with a scrim, duration badge, channel logo and '4 per row on TV at 960 dp'. Streaks is an iPhone habit tracker with no artwork of any kind, and the card being added is a week-to-date rate plus seven mini day rings. The c1 direction was rejected by its own validator for exactly this pick ('non-media product: poster (media) card geometry selected'), yet the guidance layer still promotes it to core.
The card is inserted into an existing ScrollView/VStack that already handles insets; the c1 run recorded this record as ignored for the same reason.

layout.focal_hierarchy is listed as uncovered (candidates layout-hierarchy-one-thing, anti-oversized-hero-text were dropped by the cap). That is the one real design risk in this task: a second full-height card at the top would compete with the progress ring and push the habit list below the fold on 390x844. layout.no_nested_cards survives only incidentally, via one clause of surface-elevated-cards.

why: c1 was actively harmful - two ecommerce core records (product detail page, one-page checkout) from a spurious product hint, plus a direction whose own validator failed on poster-card geometry, grid catalog layout and a sticky action bar; c2 drops the product contamination, adds the two critical concepts (comp-kpi-tile for data.kpi_comparison, impl-reuse-before-new for process.reuse_first), and the direction now proposes only the three slots the codebase already has.
